text: Advanced pancreatic cancer, previously treated with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel and now progressing. Still walking and working part-time.
relevant_if: Metastatic/advanced pancreatic cancer trial open to patients after first-line gemcitabine-based therapy (second line or later).
not_relevant_if: Treatment-naive/first-line only, resectable or adjuvant/neoadjuvant, or a different cancer.

text: Metastatic hormone-receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer that has progressed on letrozole plus palbociclib.
relevant_if: HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer trial for patients after endocrine therapy plus a CDK4/6 inhibitor.
not_relevant_if: First-line only, HER2-positive or triple-negative only, early-stage/adjuvant, or another cancer.

text: HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer with brain metastases, previously treated with trastuzumab and pertuzumab.
relevant_if: HER2+ metastatic breast cancer trial that allows or targets brain metastases and prior trastuzumab/pertuzumab.
not_relevant_if: HER2-negative only, treatment-naive only, excludes brain metastases, early-stage, or another cancer.

text: Newly diagnosed stage II triple-negative breast cancer. No treatment yet and surgery has not been done.
relevant_if: Triple-negative early breast cancer trial in the neoadjuvant (before surgery) or untreated early setting.
not_relevant_if: Metastatic-only, previously treated, HR+ or HER2+ only, or another cancer.

text: Man with ER-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer, stage III, surgery finished, deciding about adjuvant treatment.
relevant_if: Breast cancer trial that accepts male patients and fits adjuvant HR+/HER2- early or locally advanced disease.
not_relevant_if: Trials limited to female patients (filtered out), metastatic-only, or another cancer.

text: Stage IV lung adenocarcinoma with an EGFR exon 19 deletion that has progressed on osimertinib.
relevant_if: EGFR-mutant NSCLC trial for progression after a third-generation EGFR inhibitor such as osimertinib.
not_relevant_if: First-line EGFR trials requiring no prior EGFR-TKI, other biomarkers only, early-stage, or another cancer.

text: Newly diagnosed metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with an ALK rearrangement, no prior treatment.
relevant_if: ALK-positive NSCLC trial open to untreated metastatic patients.
not_relevant_if: Requires prior ALK inhibitor, other biomarkers only, early-stage, or another cancer.

text: Metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with a KRAS G12C mutation, progressed after platinum chemotherapy and pembrolizumab.
relevant_if: KRAS G12C NSCLC trial for patients after chemotherapy and immunotherapy, or general NSCLC trial allowing that setting.
not_relevant_if: First-line only, a different driver mutation required, early-stage, or another cancer.

text: Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer that relapsed after carboplatin, etoposide and atezolizumab.
relevant_if: Relapsed/refractory extensive-stage SCLC trial (second line or later).
not_relevant_if: Limited-stage or first-line only, non-small-cell lung cancer only, or another cancer.

text: Lung cancer that has spread to my brain. I never smoked and I take a targeted pill.
relevant_if: NSCLC trial open to brain metastases, ideally for targeted-therapy (EGFR/ALK) patients.
not_relevant_if: Brain tumours without lung primary, small-cell only without relevance, excludes brain metastases, or another cancer.

text: Metastatic colorectal cancer that is MSI-high (mismatch repair deficient). No treatment for metastatic disease yet.
relevant_if: MSI-H/dMMR metastatic colorectal cancer trial open to untreated patients, or MSS/MSI-agnostic first-line trials that do not exclude MSI-H.
not_relevant_if: MSS-only trials, requires prior therapy, early-stage, or another cancer.

text: Metastatic colorectal cancer with a BRAF V600E mutation, after FOLFOX and FOLFIRI.
relevant_if: BRAF V600E colorectal cancer trial for previously treated patients, or later-line colorectal trials not excluding BRAF.
not_relevant_if: First-line only, requires wild-type BRAF/RAS, early-stage, or another cancer.

text: Locally advanced rectal cancer, stage III, before any treatment. I would like options that might avoid surgery.
relevant_if: Locally advanced rectal cancer trial in the untreated setting, including organ-preservation / total neoadjuvant therapy.
not_relevant_if: Metastatic-only, previously treated, colon-only, or another cancer.

text: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that progressed on enzalutamide. No chemotherapy so far.
relevant_if: mCRPC trial for patients after an androgen-receptor pathway inhibitor and before (or allowing no) chemotherapy.
not_relevant_if: Hormone-sensitive only, requires prior docetaxel when the patient has none, localized disease, or another cancer.

text: Newly diagnosed metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer. Androgen deprivation was started two months ago, nothing else.
relevant_if: Metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer trial open to patients just starting systemic therapy.
not_relevant_if: Castration-resistant only, localized disease, requires extensive prior therapy, or another cancer.

text: Platinum-resistant high-grade serous ovarian cancer after three prior lines of treatment.
relevant_if: Platinum-resistant ovarian cancer trial allowing heavily pretreated patients.
not_relevant_if: Platinum-sensitive or first-line only, limits prior lines below three, or another cancer.

text: BRCA1-mutated advanced ovarian cancer. Finished first-line platinum chemotherapy with a complete response and is looking at maintenance treatment.
relevant_if: Ovarian cancer maintenance trial after response to first-line platinum, BRCA-mutated or biomarker-agnostic.
not_relevant_if: Platinum-resistant/relapsed treatment trials, newly diagnosed untreated only, or another cancer.

text: BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic melanoma that progressed on nivolumab plus ipilimumab.
relevant_if: Advanced melanoma trial for patients after anti-PD-1 therapy, BRAF-mutant or allowing BRAF-mutant.
not_relevant_if: Treatment-naive only, adjuvant/early-stage, BRAF wild-type required, uveal-only, or another cancer.

text: Relapsed acute myeloid leukemia with an FLT3-ITD mutation, after standard induction chemotherapy.
relevant_if: Relapsed/refractory AML trial, FLT3-targeted or open to FLT3-mutated patients.
not_relevant_if: Newly diagnosed only, other leukemias only, requires FLT3 wild-type, or another cancer.

text: Newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia. Too frail for intensive chemotherapy.
relevant_if: Newly diagnosed AML trial for patients unfit for intensive chemotherapy (for example venetoclax plus azacitidine settings).
not_relevant_if: Relapsed only, intensive-chemotherapy-fit only, other leukemias, or another cancer.

text: Relapsed and refractory multiple myeloma after lenalidomide, bortezomib and daratumumab. No CAR-T before.
relevant_if: Relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma trial for triple-class exposed patients, CAR-T/bispecific or similar.
not_relevant_if: Newly diagnosed only, requires prior CAR-T, smouldering myeloma, or another cancer.

text: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that relapsed after R-CHOP. Not a candidate for stem cell transplant.
relevant_if: Relapsed/refractory DLBCL trial that includes transplant-ineligible patients.
not_relevant_if: Newly diagnosed only, requires transplant eligibility, other lymphomas only, or another cancer.

text: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma with an FGFR2 fusion, progressed after gemcitabine and cisplatin.
relevant_if: Biliary tract/cholangiocarcinoma trial for previously treated patients, FGFR2-targeted or allowing it.
not_relevant_if: First-line only, other biomarkers required, hepatocellular carcinoma only, or another cancer.

text: Glioblastoma that came back after surgery, radiation and temozolomide.
relevant_if: Recurrent glioblastoma trial after standard chemoradiation.
not_relevant_if: Newly diagnosed only, low-grade glioma only, brain metastases only, or another cancer.

text: Newly diagnosed metastatic pancreatic cancer. No treatment yet and good performance status.
relevant_if: Metastatic pancreatic cancer trial open to untreated (first-line) patients.
not_relevant_if: Requires prior therapy (second line or later), resectable/adjuvant only, or another cancer.

text: Advanced clear cell kidney cancer that progressed after nivolumab plus cabozantinib.
relevant_if: Advanced renal cell carcinoma trial for patients after immunotherapy and a VEGF inhibitor.
not_relevant_if: Treatment-naive only, non-clear-cell only, adjuvant/localized, or another cancer.

text: Metastatic urothelial bladder cancer previously treated with platinum chemotherapy and enfortumab vedotin.
relevant_if: Advanced/metastatic urothelial cancer trial for patients after platinum and EV (third line or allowing prior EV).
not_relevant_if: First-line or EV-naive only, non-muscle-invasive only, or another cancer.

text: Advanced gastric cancer that is Claudin 18.2 positive and HER2 negative. No treatment for advanced disease yet.
relevant_if: Claudin 18.2-positive (or biomarker-open) first-line advanced gastric/GEJ trial, HER2-negative.
not_relevant_if: HER2-positive only, previously treated only, early-stage, or another cancer.

text: Recurrent, metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, HPV negative, progressed after cisplatin and pembrolizumab.
relevant_if: Recurrent/metastatic HNSCC trial for patients after platinum and anti-PD-1 therapy.
not_relevant_if: First-line only, locally advanced curative-intent only, HPV-positive only, or another cancer.

text: Four-year-old girl with newly diagnosed high-risk neuroblastoma. No treatment so far.
relevant_if: High-risk neuroblastoma trial for newly diagnosed children.
not_relevant_if: Adult-only trials, relapsed-only, low/intermediate-risk only, or another cancer.
